Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
Â
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
Â
The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
Â
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
Â
What You'll Own
Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.
Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.
Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.
Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.
Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.
Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.
Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
Â
What We're Looking For
5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.
Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.
Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.
Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.
Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.
Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
Â
Nice to have
Engineering or highly technical product background.
Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.
Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
Â
Outcome
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
Location
This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
Online assessment or practical task
Technical interview
CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.
This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Team Leadership & Performance Management
Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership
Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability
Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately
Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
Clinical Days at Goal
0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
Schedule-entry timeliness
Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
Skills:
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies
Leadership & team development
Delegation, accountability & follow-through
Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
Schedule-health oversight & workload management
Workflow optimization & accuracy
Efficient decision-making & prioritization
Cross-functional collaboration
Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy
Work Environment
Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually
Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
About the Role
We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.
As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.
We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.
Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
What You Can Expect
Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.
Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.
The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.
Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.
A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.
A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.
What We Are Looking For
7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.
Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.
Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.
Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.
In This Role, You Will
Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.
Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.
Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.
Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.
Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.
Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.
How You Work
You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.
You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.
You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.
You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.
You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.
\n
\n
Equal Employment Opportunity Information
The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.
Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.
The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.
Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.
A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.
Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.
Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.
Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.
In This Role, You Will
Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.
Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.
Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.
Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.
Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.
Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.
How You Work
You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.
You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.
You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.
You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.
You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

About the Role

You will run discovery and design workshops directly with logistics, supply chain, and procurement stakeholders â including ownership of the Indirect Procurement value stream â translate their requirements into working Oracle Fusion design and configuration, and own the documentation trail from business requirement through configuration and test. You will also own the integration design connecting Oracle Fusion to Shopify for e-commerce order and inventory synchronization, and to the client'swarehouse management system(s) for outbound and inbound logistics â alongside integration with adjacent Oracle Fusion modules as applicable.
This is a nearshore delivery role, based in Mexico or Brazil, working in a remote-first model alongside Tessera's distributed FDE delivery and AI engineering teams. Because you will be running workshops and presenting directly tobusiness stakeholders and client leadership, excellent business English â spoken and written â is essential to this role.
Key Responsibilities
â¢ Lead and facilitate business process workshops with logistics, supply chain, procurement, and operations stakeholders to capture requirements for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, spanning Inventory Management, Order Management, Indirect Procurement, and related logistics processes.
â¢ Own end-to-end functional configuration of Oracle Fusion modules â Inventory Management, Order
Management, and Procurement, with particular ownership of the Indirect Procurement value stream,
translating workshop outcomes into a working, standard-first system design.
â¢ Configure and maintain the Oracle article/item master setup in line with fashion and apparel industry best practices (e.g., style, color, and size hierarchies, seasonal and pre-pack/kit structures) and Oracle Retail conventions.

jobs.jd:
OUR MISSION
We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.
Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.
As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.
Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.
This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.
Additionally, you will:
Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology
Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally
Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations
Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders
Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations
Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders
Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently
WHAT YOU'VE DONE
6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined
You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts
Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others
You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products
You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders
You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation
Nice to haves:
Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management
Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement
OUR VALUES
At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible.
We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.
Be cautious of recruitment fraud , and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.

Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â
We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â
This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â
You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â
If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â
What you'll do:
Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â
Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â
Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â
Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â
Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â
Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â
Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â
Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â
Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â
What you'll bring:
Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â
Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â
Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â
The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â
The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â
Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â
Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â
Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â
Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â
Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â
An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â
You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â
All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â
A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ
A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ
Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ
A progressive parental leave policyÂ
Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ
What's it like to be a Fuellie?
Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â
We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â
We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â
We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â
We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â
We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â
Application process:
If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â
Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â
This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businessesâfrom exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMsâto seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But thatâs just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?
About the job
QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.
We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.
The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.
Responsibilities
Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.
Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.
Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.
Mandatory:
Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.
Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one.
Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.
You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.
Deep JavaScript and React .
Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique.
Preferred:
Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source .
Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
Apply only through our official channels. Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/
Verify the recruiterâs identity. Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @ tether.to orÂ @ tether.io
We will never request payment or financial details. Â If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.
When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.
When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.
Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.
Weâre building an AI scientist for our customers. We canât do that if we havenât built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Solutions Delivery Manager works cross-functionally with Benchling's build organization, as well as across the CX departments, to develop robust solutions that can deliver value to our customers, while improving internal knowledge and productivity.
Chemistry is one of Benchling's newest and most exciting product areas â unlocking an entirely new group of companies, scientists, and science to be done on Benchling. This role will help navigate a budding product area through to market adoption, partnering closely with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and help shape our vision in this space.
Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. They will develop, and continuously improve our solutions as both the science and Benchling product capabilities evolve. A successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams and systems, often with no existing guidance or playbook, to deliver impactful solutions and value aligned with our department and team goals.
Â

Navigate a budding product area through to market adoption â partnering with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and shape our vision in this space
Serve as a key advisor on customer accounts as an expert in the scientific and product space
Deliver services and oversee services engagements to ensure high quality solution and delivery
Build a roadmap of solution assets to deliver impactful solutions to the broader CX organization
Build and maintain solution assets, such as best practices documents
Train and educate the broader CX organization through various means (e.g. create documentation, drive enablement initiatives, refresh solutions, advise on customer engagements, etc.)
Collaborate across CX departments to reflect customer learnings into solution assets
Operationalize Benchlingâs new product introduction motions to deliver new product insights
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Strategy teams to align on product value and customer messaging
Learn existing and new verticals that Benchling services
Â
QUALIFICATIONS
Scientific and Benchling Knowledge
Fluency in medicinal chemistry or PD chemistry, ideally both
Fluency in a chemistry-focused lab informatics tool
Knowledge of Benchlingâs Platform and solutions, and technical proficiency with Benchling products is preferred
Customer Readiness
Experienced customer experience professional with a strong track record in overseeing the success of customer engagements
Superior customer service skills â the ability to be empathetic, accurate, resourceful, and conscientious with a sense of urgency
Problem Solving and Collaborative Success
Excellent oral and written communication skills to work effectively with others both inside and outside departmental boundaries, at remote locations and/or outside the company
Demonstrate ability to analyze and resolve complex problems and rapidly assimilate new knowledge and information
Flexible and able to adjust on the fly to new demands; a high sense of urgency, tendency towards action, and comfortable working through ambiguity to independently make progress on individual and team goals
Experience and Educational Requirements
6+ years of lab experience in medicinal chemistry, PD chemistry, or a closely related field
2+ years experience in customer service or customer-facing roles
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, or life sciences related field is required (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.)
Ph.D. in chemistry is preferred
Â

jobs.jd:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.
The Role
We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.
You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.
Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.
The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.
This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.
We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.
If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.
What Work Looks Like
You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.
Every day
Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.
Delighting customers
Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.
Making support smarter with AI
Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.
Keeping the product solid
Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.
Running the week
Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.
Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.
Who You Are
You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.
A Plus If You Have
Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.
How We Work Together
You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.
Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:
Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.
This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.
Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.
Benefits
Contract type: full-time or part-time
Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
Start date: negotiable

We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.
A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US
In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.
By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.
Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.
Service Rates
The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.
Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.
Independent Contractor Relationship
This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.
Qualification path
Qualification Process
No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.
Basic Requirements
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years
• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States
• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms
• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content
• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection
• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)
• Access to a personal computer
Assessment
You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

Remote | Americas, Europe, or Israel
Most AI engineers can find work.
Finding work worth doing is harder.
A.Team is an invite-only network of senior AI engineers, ML engineers, and AI architects building production AI systems for startups, enterprises, and global companies.

The Work
You'll join small teams solving real problems.
Not demos.
Not proof-of-concepts that never ship.
Not another thin wrapper around an API.
Recent work has included:
AI-native products built from 0→1
Agent architectures and orchestration systems
Enterprise AI deployments
Retrieval, evaluation, and reliability infrastructure
LLM-powered workflows and products
Machine learning platforms operating at scale
You'll work directly with founders, CTOs, and product leaders, helping shape both technical direction and execution.
Why Builders Join
The best opportunities rarely make it to the open market.
A.Team exists to solve that.
No bidding.
No prospecting.
No race to the bottom.
Just ambitious companies, difficult problems, and experienced peers.
Who Thrives Here
People who have already shipped.
Engineers who have deployed AI systems into production, understand the tradeoffs behind the hype, and know how to turn technical complexity into business value.
What matters is a track record of building and shipping.
The Details
Typical rates: $120-$170/hr
Remote
You keep 100% of your rate
Not a Fit
Early-career engineers
People without production AI experience
Small gig seekers
Developers focused primarily on simple AI wrappers or templated implementations
Apply
Tell us what you've built.

jobs.jd:
About Mitre Media
Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.
Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!
About the Role
As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.
You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.
Responsibilities
Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)
Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.
Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.
Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.
Required Technical Skills
Back-End
Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)
Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)
PostgreSQL (or MySQL)
Elasticsearch
Redis
Docker
Front-End
StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6
Tailwind CSS
HTML
HTTP
AI Integration
Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications
Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)
Nice-to-Have Technical Skills
Kubernetes for microservices orchestration
React for advanced front-end components
Graph databases for complex financial data
Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects
Required Soft Skills
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech
Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates
Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality
Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration
Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code
Team player comfortable as an individual contributor
Why Join Us?
Impactful Work : Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.
Cutting-Edge Tech : Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.
Autonomy and Influence : Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.
Competitive Compensation : $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.
Remote Flexibility : Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC
Growth Opportunities : Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.
Dynamic Culture : Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.
About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform
Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.
How to Apply
Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.jd:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.
The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
About the Role
Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:
Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
Skincare and beauty
Tech and software
Finance and investing
Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
Education
Home improvement
Automobiles and motorcycles
Health and wellness
Medical and clinical fields
Digital marketing
SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing
Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.
Responsibilities
Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team
Qualifications
Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
Portfolio featuring published work preferred
Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred
Compensation
Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.
Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate
This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page
After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate
After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate
Application Process
Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.jd:
About Us
We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.
During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!
Compensation Structure
This role is 100% commission-based , which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.
Training Period (Weeks 1–4)
We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:
Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).
Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.
Week 0: Unpaid
Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum
Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum
Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum
By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.
Post Training Period:
Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually
Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually
*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.
What will you be doing?
Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.
We are looking for team members who are:
Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.
Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.
Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.
Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.
Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!
Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.
Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!
You will need:
Home office or a quiet place to work.
Strong internet connection.
Desktop or laptop
(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)
Scheduling
Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.
*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.
Post Training:
We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:
Monday - Friday

jobs.jd:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.
As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.
We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.
Why Join Coalition Technologies?
Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:
100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
Subsidized gym memberships
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses
Office Assistant Responsibilities
As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:
Answering phones and emails
Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars
Required Skills and Qualifications
The ideal candidate will have:
Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers
Preferred Skills
The following experience is preferred but not required:
Intermediate spreadsheet skills
Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations
Remote Work Environment
Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.
Growth Opportunity
This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.
Compensation
For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.
